verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents several built-in background automations (automatic bank transaction import/matching, automated payment reminders, automatic reconciliation reports, proactive Payroll AI, rule-based transaction categorization confirmed independently by a community user), which run without manual triggering. However, these are fixed, vendor-defined automations rather than a general-purpose framework where an AI-native user can configure custom autonomous multi-step workflows, and Intuit Intelligence chat appears to be an on-demand assistant rather than a persistent background agent. Missing for 10: evidence of a user-configurable automation/workflow builder for arbitrary agentic tasks, and confirmation that Intuit Intelligence or similar AI features operate continuously/autonomously rather than on-demand.
